ModMetaData.name: RimworldMP
ModMetaData.author: RimworldMP contributors
ModMetaData.description: From-scratch RimWorld 1.7 multiplayer: shared colony, LAN TCP (protocol v3), in-game host. v0.6.0 — UI + launcher release: LAN launcher (locate/mods/host/join/handoff), P0 sim-correctness (modlist join gate, map-safe cmds, JIP load hooks, MaxClients 4), in-mod lobby (F10 / button). Requires Harmony 3. Known limitation: untested in live RW 1.7 without RIMWORLD_DIR game refs.
